productionPlan.actionPrompt: ONE noncanonical family-safe zombie-infection WHAT IF. Chris remains entirely intact in same1996 uniform: recognizable face and hair, pale ASH-GRAY skin with faint green tint, muted milky eyes with intact iris shapes, vacant distant expression, no mouth monster. Slow uneven shuffling step with shoulders slack, BOTH arms reaching forward at DIFFERENT heights and fingers relaxed open. Pistol safely holstered and knife closed. NO blood, wounds, decay, torn flesh, exposed tissue, veins, sores or gore. Make transformation visibly on character, not only scenery.
